source_nodes.orig: STRATAGEMS
source_nodes.text: STRATAGEMS

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: Command points can be spent during the battle to use Stratagems. All players can use the Core Stratagems presented here. Additional Stratagems can be found in Codexes and other publications.
source_nodes.text: Command points can be spent during the battle to use Stratagems. All players can use the Core Stratagems presented here. Additional Stratagems can be found in Codexes and other publications.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: When you use a Stratagem, reduce your CP total by the amount listed on that Stratagem. If you do not have enough CP for a specific Stratagem, you cannot use it. You can use the same Stratagem multiple times during a battle, but you cannot use the same Stratagem more than once in the same phase.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: Each Stratagem belongs to one of four categories, as described below. There are some rules (especially in Crusade games) that interact with Stratagems of a particular category.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: BATTLE TACTIC: These Stratagems bolster a unit's efficacy in battle, boosting their attacks or defensive capabilities at a critical moment.
source_nodes.text: BATTLE TACTIC: These Stratagems bolster a unit's efficacy in battle, boosting their attacks or defensive capabilities at a critical moment.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: EPIC DEED: These Stratagems are used by individual models or units to perform mighty feats of heroism.
source_nodes.text: EPIC DEED: These Stratagems are used by individual models or units to perform mighty feats of heroism.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: STRATEGIC PLOY: These Stratagems enable units to gain new strategic insights, granting them a small but valuable window of opportunity.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: WARGEAR: These Stratagems represent the effects of using specialised items of equipment in battle.

source_nodes.text: CORE - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
source_nodes.text: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.

source_nodes.label: text
source_nodes.orig: WHEN: In any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army.
